suggestions.roleTitleVi: Chuyên viên Kiểm soát Chất lượng và Kỹ thuật May
suggestions.reasoning: As generative AI and automation reshape light manufacturing, manual tasks face high exposure, but physical inspection, technical drawing interpretation, and quality assurance require tactile verification and human oversight. Grounded in the TopCV & GSO 2024 data, while routine repetitive tasks contract, specialized technical coordination remains resilient.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your 8 years of factory experience, ability to read technical drawings, and strong manual dexterity directly bridge physical craftsmanship with quality control. This pathway leverages your existing factory floor knowledge while upgrading your role to be resilient against automation.
